scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract MSB3277 assembly version conflict details
scenarios.reasoning: The agent efficiently extracted all relevant information from the binlog overview (which contained truncated but sufficient data) despite failing to read the full error details file. It correctly identified all key aspects of the build failure: the error code, conflicting assembly, affected project, conflicting versions, and target framework. The approach was efficient with only 4 tool calls.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified MSB3277 as the error code
Named System.Diagnostics.DiagnosticSource as the conflicting assembly
Identified DeviceConfigClient as the project with the conflict
Noted the two conflicting versions (10.0.0.0 vs 10.0.0.3)
Mentioned which target framework (net8.0) is affected by the conflict
